title: Human stories
principle: Build a narrative around a specific human perspective.

title: Quiet confidence
principle: Use restraint and negative space to establish confidence.

title: Rhythmic transitions
principle: Connect sequences using a repeated transition principle.

title: Unexpected humour
principle: Reveal a familiar subject through an unexpected comic setup.

title: Tactile worlds
principle: Use tangible materials to make an abstract idea accessible.

title: Visual parallels
principle: Connect two ideas through matching compositions.

title: Sound as structure
principle: Let a recurring sound define narrative sections.

title: First-person energy
principle: Use a direct perspective to invite audience participation.

title: One space, many ideas
principle: Explore multiple narrative moments inside a single location.

title: Data with a pulse
principle: Pair a data point with an understandable lived experience.

title: Type in motion
principle: Give typography a narrative role instead of using it as decoration.

title: A change of scale
principle: Shift from an intimate detail to the wider context.

title: Shared performance
principle: Use contrasting performances to reveal a common theme.

title: Participatory space
principle: Connect an audience action to a visible response.

title: A simple reveal
principle: Reserve one clear visual reveal for the central idea.
